whyItMatters: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a setup.cfg with no `python_requires`.
actions: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a setup.cfg with no `python_requires`.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm setup.cfg no longer carries a setup.cfg with no `python_requires`.
